messages.content: 你是一位資料分析師，你收到了兩個2x2交叉表，代表在兩個不同城市進行的調查結果。第一個表格是[45，55，35，65]，第二個表格是[30，70，50，50]。你被要求對兩個表格進行獨立性的卡方檢定，以確定每個城市的變數之間是否存在顯著關係。使用0.05的顯著水平臨界值進行兩次檢定。根據卡方檢定的結果，你能否判斷每個城市是否存在顯著關係？

function.name: chi_squared_test
function.description: Performs a Chi-Squared test for independence on a 2x2 contingency table. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

table.description: A 2x2 contingency table presented in array form.

alpha.description: Significance level for the Chi-Squared test. Default is 0.05. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
We need to perform chi-squared test for independence on two 2x2 tables. Table1: [45,55,35,65]. Table2: [30,70,50,50]. Use alpha=0.05. We need to compute chi-square statistic and p-value. For 2x2, degrees of freedom = (rows-1)*(cols-1)=1. We can compute expected counts: For each table.

Table1: Observed: a=45, b=55, c=35, d=65. Row totals: row1=100, row2=100. Column totals: col1=80, col2=120. Total N=200. Expected: a_exp = row1*col1/N = 100*80/200=40. b_exp=100*120/200=60. c_exp=100*80/200=40. d_exp=100*120/200=60. Compute chi-square: sum((obs-exp)^2/exp). For a: (45-40)^2/40=25/40=0.625. b: (55-60)^2/60=25/60≈0.4167. c: (35-40)^2/40=25/40=0.625. d: (65-60)^2/60=25/60≈0.4167. Sum=2.0834. p-value for df=1: chi-square 2.0834 gives p ~ 0.148. So not significant at 0.05.

Table2: Observed: a=30,b=70,c=50,d=50. Row totals: row1=100, row2=100. Column totals: col1=80, col2=120. N=200. Expected same as above: a_exp=40,b_exp=60,c_exp=40,d_exp=60. Compute chi-square: a: (30-40)^2/40=100/40=2.5. b: (70-60)^2/60=100/60≈1.6667. c: (50-40)^2/40=100/40=2.5. d: (50-60)^2/60=100/60≈1.6667. Sum=8.3334. p-value for df=1: chi-square 8.3334 gives p ~ 0.0039. So significant at 0.05.

Thus city1 no significant relationship; city2 significant relationship.
